grades.quote:
LDX.B:
    vaddr = GR[rj] + GR[rk]
    AddressComplianceCheck(vaddr)
    paddr = AddressTranslation(vaddr)
    byte = MemoryLoad(paddr, BYTE)
    GR[rd] = SignExtend(byte, GRLEN)
grades.reason: Directly specifies that signed LDX.B sign-extends and unsigned LDX.BU zero-extends to GRLEN.

grades.quote:
halfword = MemoryLoad(paddr, HALFWORD)
    GR[rd] = ZeroExtend(halfword, GRLEN)
grades.reason: Provides an auxiliary example of unsigned-load zero-extension, but concerns halfwords rather than bytes.

grades.quote:
byte = MemoryLoad(paddr, BYTE)
    GR[rd] = ZeroExtend(byte, GRLEN)
grades.reason: Answers the unsigned-byte half of the comparison, but does not describe signed-byte loads.

grades.quote: The LW instruction loads a 32-bit value from memory and sign-extends this to 64 bits before storing it in register _rd_ for RV64I. The LWU instruction, on the other hand, zero-extends the 32-bit value from memory for RV64I. LH and LHU are defined analogously for 16-bit values, as are LB and LBU for 8-bit values.
grades.reason: Directly establishes that LB sign-extends and LBU zero-extends an 8-bit value to the 64-bit register width.
